distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Shanxi with a county locality transcribed provisionally as Jiangxian under the name Scolytus parviclaviger. The spelling of this locality in the original source has not been independently resolved, and no modern county assignment is inferred. Huang & Lu (2015) retained Shanxi without finer locality detail. This is published geographic evidence; the occurrence assessment remains Candidate. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Jilin as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.
